author: Ivan Lukan
developer_reply: Hi there, Ivan! We'll keep your feedback in mind as we continue to work to improve Habitica. You can send our team specific feedback and requests directly by going to Menu - About -Support - Send Feedback.

author: Vito Koršič
developer_reply: Thanks so much for your rating here, Vito. If you’d like to share any feedback with us directly, you can do that via Menu - About - Support - Send Feedback.

text: so far so good, my only complain is the difficulty of obtaining gems (a second currency used for purchasing of cosmetic items and quest scrolls).
author: Sad Dust
developer_reply: Thanks for your review! As you noted, all items that can be obtained with gems are cosmetic, but another option is that quests for pets/potions can be shared with your partymates. There are also occasionally gem sales, like the one happening right now.
